title: Effective policies per scope
description: Shows all policies that actually apply to a specific scope, helping debug policy conflicts and understand cumulative governance.
example_prompt: "List all effective policies at scope '{scope}' (subscription/RG/resource). Show: policy name, assignment scope (inherited from where), effect, parameters, and exemptions if any. Identify conflicting policies (e.g., one audits and another denies the same condition)."
